content.text: Finally, let me verify the files one more time and create a summary verification script:

input.command: cd /mnt/user-data/outputs && sha256sum met_inventory*.tsv > SHA256SUMS && cat SHA256SUMS && echo "" && echo "Files ready for download:" && ls -lh standardize_tsv.py met_inventory_standardized.tsv CHECKSUMS.txt STANDARDIZATION_REPORT.md SHA256SUMS
input.description: Generate final SHA-256 verification file and list all output files
